items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: Get the place on good as one of you, Russ.

ctx.x: I'm enjoying it. I wanted you to play a little with Ada and a little with Billy or something. Look at you all.
Get the place on good as one of you, Russ.
I'll turn the machine off. How long have you been playing, Russ?
